evidence.excerpt: A blend composition for the seal layer of cast polyolefin films comprising 65–80 wt% metallocene linear low-density polyethylene with 1-octene comonomer, 15–25 wt% very-low-density polyethylene with density in the range 0.895–0.905 g/cm³, and 5–10 wt% low-density polyethylene with melt flow index below 1.0 g/10 min. The composition achieves a seal-initiation temperature below 100 °C at standard jaw conditions (0.3 N/mm², 0.4 s) and a plateau seal strength above 27 N/25 mm, providing a usable sealing window of at least 30 °C. Applicable to monolayer films and as the seal layer of coextruded or laminated multilayer structures for VFFS packaging.
